fields.topic: SiC/SiC population, size and source consistency
fields.finding: Mini-composite tensile gauge area is missing. The pilot appendix's specimen labels and stated strength range need reconciliation; the scale table header has a unit inconsistency. The compression study uses a different 2.5D architecture and only three coupons.
fields.needed: Gauge area, full raw data, corrected labels/range/units, fitting details, anisotropic failure mechanisms and matched full-component compression/tension statistics.
fields.effect: Reported tensile batch m/scale values are preserved separately, not combined with the 460 MPa compression mean or monolithic weakest-link scaling.
